findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_road_status, stop_watch · Public sink: find_sharing, check_transit_disruption, watch_situation · Destructive: check_transit_disruption.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_road_status, stop_watch · Public sink: find_sharing, check_transit_disruption, watch_situation · Destructive: check_transit_disruption

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
